package governor

import "time"

// This file is added only to the disposable governor test overlay, never to
// a production build or the existing #115 test files. Hooks observe real
// append/sync/latch completion and never change their result.
func ObserveAbsenceJournalForTest(machine *Governor, record func(string, time.Time)) error {
	ledger, err := LoopbackCarrierTestLedger(machine)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ledger.hooks.afterAppendBeforeSync = func(entry pairingJournalRecord) error {
		if entry.Type == pairingRecordBurnAndAdmit {
			record("burn_appended", time.Now())
		}
		if entry.Type == pairingRecordFinish {
			record("finish_appended", time.Now())
		}
		return nil
	}
	ledger.hooks.afterSync = func(entry pairingJournalRecord) error {
		if entry.Type == pairingRecordBurnAndAdmit {
			record("burn_synced", time.Now())
		}
		if entry.Type == pairingRecordFinish {
			record("finish_synced", time.Now())
		}
		return nil
	}
	machine.owner.tripStore.hooks.afterTripLatchSync = func() error {
		record("persistent_trip_latched", time.Now())
		return nil
	}
	return nil
}
